scenarios.title: Initialization
scenarios.description: Provision a WLAN profile and register/unregister the background task for the hotspot authentication event.

controls.name: UnregisterButton
controls.label: Unregister
controls.expected_initial_state: disabled (enabled only after a task is registered)

scenarios.title: Authentication by background task
scenarios.description: Informational scenario: authentication handled by the registered background task. No interactive controls beyond the shared status area.

scenarios.title: Authentication by foreground app
scenarios.description: Foreground authentication of a hotspot event. Authenticate/Skip/Abort act on a live NetworkOperatorHotspotAuthenticationContext and are disabled until such an event fires.

notes: Button enabled/disabled states are the key behavioral signal for this sample because most actions require a real Wi-Fi hotspot authentication context (signed WLAN provisioning XML / a live auth event) that is unavailable on a dev box.
